name: Clone Slopes: Clone 0 moves north · 2t at (0, 5, 1) [case 424]
description:
clone must be trapped before you can slide up it

One Up command in a 6×6 room; expect exactly 2 ticks after Start.
Player: 1 cell, starting at (0, 5, 1); Clone 0: 1 cell, starting at (2, 2, 1); Box 0: 1 cell, starting at (2, 2, 2). Terrain and fixtures: Limestone, Yellow clone slope, Basalt wall.

Tick 1: Player moves 1 north; Clone 0 moves 1 north; Box 0 moves 1 north.
Tick 2: Box 0 moves 1 south and 1 down.

Coordinates are (x, y, z); north decreases y. Every frame is checked in all four rotations. Unmentioned objects retain their authored positions and states.
